decision_summary: Restructure as a five-subsystem harness operating system with separate autonomous source stack and Codex runtime package.

decisions.decision: Use short AGENTS.md and MASTER_PROMPT_ROUTER.md; move detail to docs/state/verification/lifecycle.
decisions.consequence: Reduces instruction-load risk and creates stable startup path.

decisions.decision: Keep autonomous/99_total as actual-use bundle regenerated only from autonomous source-of-truth files.
decisions.consequence: Codex runtime is no longer copied into 99_total.

decisions.decision: Keep codex/ as independent runtime package validated by runtime fitness and boundary preservation.
decisions.consequence: No textual mirror requirement against autonomous source files.

decisions.decision: Hold v36_candidate until real behavioral benchmark/ablation evidence exists.
decisions.consequence: Do not copy to v36 or update stable pointers in this run.

release_policy: v36_candidate cannot be called v36 until all release gates pass with behavior evidence.
